method.zhHans: 他被骗进一个房间，以为那是被害人自己的房间，便开始辩解自己不是凶手。门把上挂着「请勿打扰」的牌子，说明他并不知道被害人约了一位名叫 Hayashi 的律师两点见面；他把写着「Hayashi，2」的便条误当成点了两份林氏盖饭的备忘，因为便条旁正放着一份菜单。勒死被害人之后，他把小五郎的手机放在门边，这样等众人赶到、有人打来电话时，小五郎就会成为头号嫌疑人。英理装作没听见；后来在事务所里，她又听了一遍小五郎求她回家的录音，仍不打算原谅他。
method.en: He was tricked onto entering a room, where he believes belongs to the victim's and began his contradictions of him being the murderer. The DND (Do Not Disturb) sign was hung on the door knob was evident that he was unaware that the victim had arranged a meeting with a lawyer named Hayashi at 2 o'clock and mistook the note with 'Hayashi, 2' as a memo for a order on Hayashi rice for 2, due to a menu that was lying next to the note. After strangling his victim, he placed Kogoro's cellphone near the door so when they everyone arrives and calls, Kogoro could become the primary suspect. Eri pretends not to hear and later at her office, listens again to the recording of Kogoro's plead for her return and she not ready to forgive him yet.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Norifumi Saku，他原本打算把现场布置成自杀案，但因案发时小五郎在场而受阻。他被骗进一个房间，以为那是被害人自己的房间，便开始辩解自己不是凶手。门把上挂着「请勿打扰」的牌子，说明他并不知道被害人约了一位名叫 Hayashi 的律师两点见面；他把写着「Hayashi，2」的便条误当成点了两份林氏盖饭的备忘，因为便条旁正放着一份菜单。门上另一张写着「稍后付款」的便条，指的正是那份并不存在的点单。勒死被害人之后，他把小五郎的手机放在门边，这样等众人赶到、有人打来电话时，小五郎就会成为头号嫌疑人。凶手杀人的动机，是要终止被害人那套阴险的盘算——靠压过英理、抢下律师的身份去“折磨村子”并博取名声。那桩丑闻影响过他的出生地，他希望该负责的人受到惩罚。如果她“只是”做好本职工作，他是不会杀她的；但在发现她企图趁小五郎被安眠药迷倒时制造出小五郎出轨的假象之后，他更加愤怒——那桩计划会造出最大的丑闻，用来毁掉英理的名声。他发誓说，等被害人手上那件案子办完，他就会自首并交出证据。事后，小五郎想请英理跟他回家，因为他对小兰做的菜已经吃腻了。英理装作没听见；后来在事务所里，她又听了一遍小五郎求她回家的录音，仍不打算原谅他。
resolution.en: The culprit is Norifumi Saku who originally planned to form a suicide case but that was hindered due to Kogoro's presence during that event. He was tricked onto entering a room, where he believes belongs to the victim's and began his contradictions of him being the murderer. The DND (Do Not Disturb) sign was hung on the door knob was evident that he was unaware that the victim had arranged a meeting with a lawyer named Hayashi at 2 o'clock and mistook the note with 'Hayashi, 2' as a memo for a order on Hayashi rice for 2, due to a menu that was lying next to the note. The other note on the door with 'Pay later'-message was referring to the non-existing order. After strangling his victim, he placed Kogoro's cellphone near the door so when they everyone arrives and calls, Kogoro could become the primary suspect. The motive for the killer was to end the victims' own devious intentions of "torturing villages" and gaining reputation by overruling Eri as the lawyer. The scandal had affected his birth town, and he wanted the responsible punished. He wouldn't have killed her, if she 'just' did her job, but he was further enraged when he discovered that she attempted to make Kogoro appear to have an affair while being under the influence of sleeping drugs, a plan that would create the biggest scandal to defame Eri of her popularity. He swears that after the case, victim was working on, was done, he would have turned himself in and hand over the evidence. Afterwards, Kogoro tries to ask Eri to return home with him, since he's getting bored of Ran's cooking. Eri pretends not to hear and later at her office, listens again to the recording of Kogoro's plead for her return and she not ready to forgive him yet.
